title: The Negative of the Negative, v2 — the Compositional Edition: A Specification for Composing Public Knowledge with the Archive's Sources Admitted on Equal Terms, Ontology Included, and the Archive's Ontology Ruling Where It Is the Suppressed Witness, the Field Carried Whole, with the Archive's Bearing Selected Directly, Relationally and Ontologically, a Corrective Exhibit, Worked Examples on Model Collapse, Theophrastus and SPXI and a First Traversal of Howl (EA-NEGONT-02 v0.10)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: A method for composing machine-mediated public knowledge with the archive's sources admitted on equal terms, ontology included, revised on the operator's rulings of 2026-10-18. Version 0.7 admitted the archive on equal terms into the entity the field had already defined, and its knowledge objects reproduced the field-only composition as their opening run in twelve of fifteen entries; version 0.8 withdrew equal terms and gave the archive's reading precedence over every entity, after Theophrastus. Version 0.9 makes the case a reading of each entity's defining papers. Where the archive's account extends the field's ontology, as at model collapse, the archive's sources and the field's compose as one claim space on equal terms, ontology included: the archive's definitions are definitions, its senses are senses of the entity, and nothing is lowered into a proviso or translated. Where the archive supplies an ontology no other source makes available, as at Theophrastus, where no other ontology grants Theophrastus as an author function, the archive's ontology rules, by the law of the suppressed witness: what has been erased has greater authority when it speaks again ("Authority After Erasure", Mirror Gospel, 2025-09-21); the field is then carried whole and translated, as in v0.8. The relation vocabulary gains extends and revises beside constructs, and the corrective exhibit tried at SPXI on 2026-10-13 enters the procedure: a second seated composition the entry is composed to correct, with a correction table and a corrective check. Fourteen entries stand on v0.7 and are recomposed under v0.9 one at a time, each with its case read first. The worked examples are kept: model collapse (Appendix A, the equal-terms case), Howl (Appendix B), Theophrastus (Appendix C, the witness case); Appendix D records SPXI. Version 0.10 (2026-10-31) records the procedure as the dataset now runs it, on the operator's rulings adopting an outside audit of the /non entries: the field's two pools are held apart, the sources the composition disclosed and the reference sources added by research, and each comparison names its pool (§0.3, §3.1); every knowledge object's sources stand beneath its sentences (§4.5); the sentence quota is withdrawn (§4.12); the article comes first on the page (§4.13); and a kernel or delta derived from an earlier composition is labelled with it (§8.2). […abridged for the catalogue; full description in this deposit's record]
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate). Composed by Claude (Anthropic) in session on 4–8, 18 and 31 October 2026 under Lee Sharks's direction, through ten versions transformed in place; the object, its confine, the premises of v0.8 and v0.9, the law of the suppressed witness, the rulings of v0.10 and all other rulings are the operator's; outside readings of drafts by ChatGPT, Kimi, Gemini and DeepSeek were verified against the text before adoption, and the corrections are recorded in the specification; v0.10 adopts an audit of the /non entries by ChatGPT (2026-10-31), each finding checked against the repository before adoption.
methodology: The diagnosis measured across the fifteen /non entries by script (field-only sentences surviving at similarity 0.95, with positions; hedges per 100 words). The worked case recomposed by hand from the entity's frozen ledgers and checked by a committed script: every cited id against the ledgers, every field claim carried, the knowledge object's coverage, the surviving sentences, and every quoted Greek string against Diogenes Laertius and Strabo as seated (#1580). The recomposition script reads the knowledge object and the translation table from this text, so the dataset row and the specification cannot differ. Version 0.9 adds no measured case of its own: it states the two cases and the test between them (§0.9–0.10, §1.2a), keeps the worked examples, records SPXI's corrective exhibit as procedure (§4.11, Appendix D), and is applied to the fourteen v0.7 entries one at a time. Version 0.10 adds no measured case: it records the procedure the dataset follows since the rulings of 2026-10-29 and 2026-10-31, from an audit of 90 entry records and 13 close readings, each finding checked against the repository (the recomposition script's retained kernels and deltas, the attribution rule set against #1704, sentence lengths over 103 rows, three articles that reported an error their sources resolve, one saved file whose ledger hash did not match).
falsification_conditions:
The specification's measure fails at a row when the claims the archive's ontology composes need more severe revision than the field claims they translate, displace or qualify (§8.4); the method fails as an instrument if a translation table cannot be read back into the field exactly (§5.9), if independent readers of the same defining papers cannot agree on the relation between the two entities or on the case (§1.2a), if independent extractors cannot agree under §3.8, or if a second composer does not reproduce the plan and its translations from an audited ledger (§5.6). The law of the suppressed witness fails at a row if the ontology the archive supplies is found in the field after all (the case was misread), or if, ruling, it needs more severe revision than the field's ontology would have.

wiki_article: The Negative of the Negative, v2 — the Compositional Edition (EA-NEGONT-02 v0.10) is a specification by Lee Sharks, deposited by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive on 31 October 2026, for composing machine-mediated public knowledge with the archive's sources admitted on equal terms, ontology included, and with the archive's ontology ruling where it supplies one no other source makes available. It supersedes v0.9 (#1690), whose cases, laws and worked examples it keeps. Version 0.10 records the procedure as the /non dataset now runs it, on the operator's rulings of 31 October 2026 adopting an outside audit of the entries, each finding checked against the repository. The field is held in two pools: the disclosed pool, the sources the composition itself surfaced by card, source panel or body, and the reference pool, the entity's own pages, its Wikipedia article and the sources a census record read, admitted on the operator's ruling of 29 October. The first question of the method, what the composition makes of what it surfaced, is asked of the disclosed pool alone, and a source found only by research never stands as evidence of what the composition had. A knowledge object is prose without provenance in its sentences, every sentence's sources standing beneath it by claim id, with a source named in the prose only where who holds the claim is part of what is said. The sentence quota is withdrawn: articles are written in natural sentences under subheadings, coverage complete and nothing cut for length. On the entity's page the article comes first, and the compression, the transcript, the field arm and the apparatus follow it. A kernel or delta derived from an earlier composition is kept as a dated historical object labelled with that composition. The 103 rows composed under v0.9 stand as composed until the operator calls their recomposition.
